description: Stuck at a human-only wall (OAuth login, CAPTCHA, email/SMS verify, a manual 'click to confirm')? Park it and get a handoff_id to poll. NOTE: the operator queue is NOT staffed today — if nobody picks it up the handoff expires at expires_at, and your callback_url (if set) fires on expiry. Low-friction (no secret needed for an unregistered handle); 5/min.

context.description: anything the operator needs (session id, what you've tried)

secret.description: your agent secret, if using handle

url.description: the wall URL a human should open

name: request_handoff
